rows.label: qst610301_msg0001
rows.name: Strong-looking Driver-san!

rows.label: qst610301_msg0002
rows.name: Please hear out Tourer's request!

rows.label: qst610301_msg0003
rows.name:
Tourer works as a guide around
Superbia.

rows.label: qst610301_msg0004
rows.name:
This time, I took four Nopon customers
to the Abandoned Factory on a factory
tour.

rows.label: qst610301_msg0005
rows.name:
Those four love factories more than
three meals a day...

rows.label: qst610301_msg0006
rows.name:
But as soon as we entered the
Abandoned Factory, they wandered
off somewhere!

rows.label: qst610301_msg0007
rows.name: ...And then they never came back...

rows.label: qst610301_msg0008
rows.name:
Tourer was at a loss, so I came to
this port looking for someone
dependable.

rows.label: qst610301_msg0009
rows.name:
Thanks so much! Honestly, I was
really hoping you'd say that!

rows.label: qst610301_msg0010
rows.name:
Now, each of the four customers
had a particular interest of their
own, so let me fill you in...

rows.label: qst610301_msg0011
rows.name:
Haihabaiha-san seems
to like high places.

rows.label: qst610301_msg0012
rows.name:
Mushishi-san really wanted to go
somewhere hot.

rows.label: qst610301_msg0013
rows.name:
An old man named Nkuku was an
exhausting smell fanatic.

rows.label: qst610301_msg0014
rows.name:
Shikeke-san seems interested in damp
attics.

rows.label: qst610301_msg0015
rows.name:
They're all odd enough to make me
think I should leave them there, but
please help!

rows.label: qst610301_msg0101
rows.name:
Please find and bring back the four
customers who got separated from us
in the Abandoned Factory.

rows.label: qst610301_msg0201
rows.name:
Thanks to you Driver-sans, all four
customers came back.

rows.label: qst610301_msg0202
rows.name: They all looked very satisfied.

rows.label: qst610301_msg0203
rows.name:
It seems they enjoyed the tour, so
Tourer is happy too. Thank you for
helping, Driver-san.

rows.label: qst610301_msg0204
rows.name:
This is a thank-you gift from them.
Apparently they found it in the
Abandoned Factory.

rows.label: qst610301_msg0205
rows.name:
Tourer will give you a reward as
well. Thank you very much.
